_readme: The register: every minisite and capability on motdang.net, one card each.
Read by sites_layer.py. The front page's six, /sites/, the shelf bands, the nets, the
search cards (docs/data/sites.json, read by the Worker), the sitemap and llms.txt all
come from here. Nan 2026-09-28: all new sites carry cards.
cards[]   id, href (relative to motdang.net/, or a full URL for another host),
th, en, line_th, line_en, icon (an i-* id in docs/icons.svg),
shipped (YYYY-MM-DD, or null when not known), group (a key in groups),
where (cm | cr | both | a province key in coverage.json | elsewhere), shelves (shelf keys whose pages it heads),
net (a key in nets.json), words (what a reader might type), fav (Nan's pick),
until (YYYY-MM-DD: off the front page after it), season (["MM-DD", "MM-DD"]: on the
front page only inside that stretch of each year; sites_layer.timing)
on (YYYY-MM-DD: the day it happens, shown on the front tile in place of shipped),
picture (a file in assets/front/pics/ for the front tile) with picture_by (its credit)
pages[]   [href, group]: a page listed in /sites/ under its own <h1>, no card of its own
not_sites a path under docs/ that is not a site (tools, forms, data, stubs)
A card may also travel with its site: assets/sites/<slug>/card.json (same fields,
href filled in from the folder) is read on every build.
